title: Workspace neurons are dense in prefrontal, parieto-temporal and cingulate cortex

statements.text: Conscious access occurs when information is made globally available through a network of neurons with long-range axons densely distributed in prefrontal, parieto-temporal and cingulate cortices.

sources.quote: conscious access occurs when incoming information is made globally available to multiple brain systems through a network of neurons with long-range axons densely distributed in prefrontal, parieto-temporal, and cingulate cortices
